title: Zesty Venezuelan Tofu Salad
description: A bright, refreshing salad with citrus-marinated tofu, roasted corn, black beans, and a touch of habanero, perfect for a quick hangover cure.

ingredients.name: Firm tofu
ingredients.notes: cut into 1‑inch cubes, press to remove excess moisture

instructions: Press tofu cubes for 15 minutes to remove moisture, then pat dry.
In a bowl whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, lime juice, minced habanero (if using), 1 tsp salt, and ½ tsp pepper.
Add tofu cubes to the bowl, toss until evenly coated, and let marinate for 10 minutes.
Heat a non‑stick skillet over medium‑high heat and sear tofu until golden on all sides, about 5 minutes total.
While tofu cooks, roast corn kernels in a dry skillet or oven at 400°F (200°C) until slightly charred, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl combine roasted corn, black beans, sliced red onion, diced avocado, and chopped cilantro.
Fold the seared tofu into the bowl, stirring gently to mix.
Taste and adjust seasoning with extra salt or pepper if desired. Serve immediately.
